name: waitlist
title: Waitlist
description: A centred early-access page with a badge, large gradient headline, three stat tiles, an email field and a pink Join button. Submitting swaps the form for a thank-you pill, with avatars and a joined count below.
use: A product or feature is not live yet and you need to collect early-access emails on a single page.
avoid: Sites that need reusable blocks: copy, stats and avatars are hardcoded and the whole page is one piece.
a11y: The email field relies on its placeholder with no label, every avatar repeats the alt Avatar, and the drifting spotlights ignore reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark full-width page lit by soft pink diagonal spotlights and drifting white dots. A pale badge sits above a big Join the Waitlist headline, then three bordered stat tiles, an email field and a pink button, with a small avatar row below.
behaves: Content fades up on load while the spotlights drift and particles react to the pointer. Submitting the email briefly shows Joining then replaces the field and button with a glowing thank-you pill.
customise: The headline, subtitle, stats, avatar images and joined count are written into the file, so changes need source edits. Submission is simulated and spotlight gradients are internal defaults.
weight: moderate: A 100-particle canvas loop, two drifting spotlight layers and small entrance animations.
